note: A mode is HOW a person works right now (owner D-5, 2026-11-21): it changes what comes first and what an AI review checks, never what is allowed. It lives on the user profile (npdev ai users mode), NPDEV_MODE overrides it for one shell, and no Manager screen changes.

business.label: Business
business.reviewFocus: Check that the app does what the person asked for, in words a non-programmer would use.

commercial.label: Commercial
commercial.reviewFocus: Check that the demo looks good and is complete: plausible example data, every screen reachable, no raw technical names on screen.

qa.label: QA
qa.reviewFocus: Check probe coverage, access by role, and visual regressions: every rule has a probe and every role sees only what it may.

technical.label: Technical
technical.reviewFocus: Check flow complexity, keyword count and security: unused steps, unbounded loops, secrets, extension code.
